jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Transaction Risk
jobs.jd:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Transaction Risk team builds the machine learning systems behind Stripe Radar, helping businesses prevent fraud and abuse while letting legitimate customers through. We combine intelligence from across Stripe’s global network with real-time models and AI agents to protect businesses across the customer lifecycle, from signup and free trials to payments and ongoing usage, with a growing focus on the emerging threats facing AI companies.

The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle and solving emerging token fraud problems to make Stripe the default fraud and abuse solution for AI.

What you’ll do

You will own major ML systems and initiatives from problem definition to production. You'll find where ML can make the biggest difference, design the approach, build and ship models and the systems around them, and keep improving them as data, users, and attackers change.

Your work may include protecting businesses from abuse across the customer lifecycle, building adaptive and customizable fraud systems for Stripe's largest users, or extending risk intelligence to 50+ global payment methods. Across all of these, you'll use modern approaches, such as transformer models over payment data, graph intelligence across consumers, and LLMs that detect emerging attacks. 

You will have opportunities to ship 0→1 products, and to improve mission-critical ML models operating at Stripe scale, often driving several efforts in parallel and setting the technical bar for the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of ML projects end to end, from framing the problem and sizing the opportunity through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Build, train, evaluate, and deploy models that detect fraud and abuse across Stripe’s global network, and own the production systems they run on.
  • Investigate emerging fraud and abuse patterns, decide where ML can have the most impact, and quickly turn those insights into shipped protections.
  • Design features, datasets, and evaluation strategies for noisy, delayed, and adversarial environments, and set the bar for experimental rigor.
  • Make sound architecture and modeling tradeoffs between model quality, legitimate-user impact, latency, reliability, and operational cost.
  • Be the go-to expert for the systems you own: lead incident response for model regressions, reduce operational toil, and make your systems easy for others to build on.
  • Partner with engineering, product, data science, risk experts, and leading Stripe users to turn modeling improvements into differentiated Radar products.
  • Turn recurring problems into reusable components, tools, and AI-assisted workflows that speed up the whole team.
  • Mentor engineers, give thoughtful design and code reviews, and help new teammates ramp up quickly.

Who you are

You are an experienced ML engineer who combines deep modeling expertise with strong engineering judgment. You've owned ML systems in production, shipped multiple meaningful improvements, and made the people around you more effective. You move fast without breaking things, you're comfortable leading through ambiguity, and you're excited to work at the frontier of payments and AI, turning advances in machine learning into production systems that address new forms of fraud and abuse.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • A track record of leading ML projects from problem definition to production, with measurable impact.
  • Deep foundations in machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design.
  • Strong programming and software-engineering skills, with experience writing tested, maintainable code for production ML applications.
  • Experience designing and operating production ML systems, including several of: large-scale data and feature pipelines, distributed model training, low-latency inference, model deployment, or production monitoring.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or technically leading projects with multiple contributors.
  • Ability to investigate ambiguous problems, reason from data, and choose pragmatic technical approaches.
  • Ability to communicate technical ideas and results clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience applying ML to fraud detection, integrity, trust and safety, identity, cybersecurity, or another adversarial domain.
  • Experience developing or productionizing modern deep learning, graph-learning, or LLM-based approaches.
  • Experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency ML systems at scale.
  • Experience owning the operational health of critical ML systems, including on-call, incident response, and migrations.

jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
jobs.jd:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.
  • Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.
  • Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.
  • Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.
  • Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.
  • Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

 

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.
  2. Votre code est testé et maintenable.
  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.
  4. La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.
  5. Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.
  6. Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.
  • Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.
  • Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.
  • Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.
  • Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle com

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.jd:
Forward Deployed AI Engineer

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

About the job

Global AI Strategy & Solutions defines how DEPT®’s clients respond as AI agents become the primary layer between customers and brands. The Future of the Customer Journey (FCJ) is the team’s flagship offer: it maps how AI systems intermediate customer journeys, diagnoses where a brand’s product reality diverges from what AI systems say about it, and directs investment accordingly. Growth and strategy teams across markets are selling and delivering it now.

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you are an embedded builder inside that motion. You will sit with growth and strategy teams, understand the problem in front of them, and answer with working software rather than documentation. You will convert FCJ methodology into agentic components, prototypes, and internal tools, and integrate with infrastructure that lets new prototypes appear in days. When needed, you will work across global client projects on a partially billable basis, making sure the firm-wide strategy is captured and implemented properly rather than reinvented market by market. As components mature, you will collaborate with product and craft teams to keep everything compatible with the long-term platform and hand over cleanly. 

You will be given broad problem statements to help collaborate and solve, not specific product ideas and features to create. We are not looking for someone to lead on devops or CI/CD, this is about having great ideas that are sensitive to our clients’ real challenges, and shipping prototypes and strategic tools rapidly. 

Your most important collaboration is with the FCJ core team on the global growth strategy: deciding what gets built next, for which market, to unlock which engagement. The toolchain will keep changing underneath you, new models, new vendor products, new technology-partner platforms, and that is the point. This role suits an engineer who learns by shipping and treats every new AI product as something to master in the field.

Responsibilities

  • Work with the FCJ core team on the global growth strategy, converting methodology into working agentic components, prototypes, and internal tools.
  • Collaborate closely with growth and strategy teams to understand their problems and provide working solutions at prototype pace.
  • Work across global client projects on a partially billable basis, ensuring the firm-wide FCJ strategy is captured and implemented consistently across markets.
  • Collaborate with product and craft teams where necessary to document integration paths, maintain platform compatibility, and hand over validated components.
  • Work with technology partners to evaluate, adopt, and integrate new AI products; maintain an AI-native toolchain and share what works across markets.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience prototyping and shipping software in any modern backend language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar), with the ability to leverage AI tooling to spin up prototype frontends and APIs quickly.
  • Experience building applications across the mainstream LLM model families (Gemini, GPT, Claude), connecting models to enterprise data and tools using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and skills-based agent systems.
  • Proficiency in working with APIs to connect different services, authentication, data exchange, and integration across platforms.
  • Experience developing agentic systems with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent.
  • AI-native way of working: AI tooling is the default across coding, research, and delivery, with comfort spanning the tools in use across different markets.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a forward-deployed, customer engineering, solutions engineering, or applied AI role within an agency, consultancy, or AI company.
  • Experience presenting working software to non-technical stakeholders, including strategists and clients, and iterating live on their feedback.
  • Knowledge of emerging integration standards such as OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to business systems.
  • Knowledge of any of the following: paid media, social platforms, user behaviour, agentic commerce, or generative engine optimisation (GEO).
  • Experience with evaluation, tracing, and observability for LLM applications.
  • Demonstrated learning mindset: a record of adopting new AI products from technology partners quickly, learning by doing rather than waiting for training.

We Offer

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office in London).
  • An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies
  • Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme.
  • 26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays).
  • Help getting you to work with a season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme.
  • Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents.
  • Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.
  • Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and eve

Rather than shipping static tools, we partner closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions, where the value is created in the implementation, not just the codebase. The Role Most graduate schemes put you on a rotation for a year before you touch anything real. Here you'll be working on a live customer problem in your first month. We're looking for Junior Forward Deployed Engineers to join the team and: Deploy our existing product offering to new and existing customers. Own, define and build new use cases on top of our core data asset and product, delivering bespoke value and solving real, unique problems for each customer. What you'll get: A rare, in-demand skillset. You'll work hands-on with Palantir Foundry every day, building deep expertise in a platform few engineers get access to. No prior Foundry experience needed. We'll teach you, and that's the point. Someone to learn from. You'll pair with a senior engineer from day one. What you'll do Deploy and customise the STRATOS core product suite for new and existing customers. Contribute to the STRATOS core product suite, extending existing products and helping build new ones from the ground up. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ops
jobs.jd: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale. What You’ll Do: Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines. Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision. Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end. Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code. Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases. Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request. Partner with research to productionize new models. What You’ll Bring: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs. Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected. GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization. Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling. Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking. Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion). Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits for U.S.-based roles: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina 42 days of paid time off, including: 15 PTO days 10 sick days 15 company holidays 2 floating holidays Generous parental leave & fertility support 401(k) retirement savings plan Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees One Medical membership, and more!

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer – Applied AI FDE
jobs.jd: Team Bio: ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. As a Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Singapore
jobs.jd: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more . Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment. What You’ll Do We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality. You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab. The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next. Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder. Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against. Role and Responsibilities 0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure. Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work. Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4–12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success. Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints. Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems than anyone else at Roboflow. You'll surface the gap between what the customer says they want, what they actually need, and what the machine operators on the floor think. That feedback loop back to Product and Engineering shapes what we build next, and it's one of the most valuable things FDEs bring back to the company. Knowledge Transfer & Handoff: Document your deployment architecture, create runbooks, and train the customer’s team so they can operate the system independently. Provide a clean handoff to Roboflow’s Implementation Engineers for scaling and expansion. De-risk New Deployments: Identify and resolve technical risks early. If a customer’s environment won’t support the planned architecture, you find the alternative before it becomes a project failure. Shape the Deployment Playbook: Codify repeatable deployment patterns, starter templates, and reusable artifacts that make future deployments faster and more reliable. The Skillset You’ll Bring Meaningful experience deploying technology in physical-world environments. We value breadth, working across different industries, hardware platforms, and deployment contexts, over depth at a single company. The best FDEs we've hired have built things in factories, warehouses, construction sites, or labs before ever touching a vision model. Strong proficiency in Python; experience with systems-level work (Docker, Kubernetes, networking, Linux) is highly valued. Hands-on experience deploying machine learning or computer vision models to production; you understand the gap between a working notebook and a reliable pipeline. Experience with edge computing hardware and constraints (NVIDIA Jetson, industrial cameras, limited connectivity, on-premise security requirements). Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills; you’re the person who figures out why it works in staging but not in production. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, AGI/AI Security
jobs.jd: We are seeking an Applied Scientist to contribute to research and development of novel security validation and monitoring techniques for AI systems at scale. You will own and contribute to four critical work-streams: 1. Real-Time Agent Monitoring Design and implement scientific approaches for continuous behavioral analysis of AI agents in production—detecting anomalous actions, prompt injection exploitation, and policy violations in real time. 2. Protection & Automated Remediation Invent and deliver novel protection technologies and automated remediation techniques building on research in security, cryptography, privacy, automated reasoning, and others domains, to enable safe and secure agentic AI models and AI applications. 3. AI Application and Capabilities Validation Invent and deliver scalable methodologies for security testing of AI applications and AI capabilities (e.g. MCP, skills), including adversarial robustness evaluation, safety guardrail bypass detection, tool-use authorization boundaries, and trust boundary verification. 4. AI Asset Discovery & Inventory Research and build scalable techniques to automatically discover, identify, and catalog all AI-enabled applications, services, and capabilities across the company—maintaining a comprehensive, continuously updated database of AI assets. Key job responsibilities Invent • Identify and frame new research challenges in AI security where problems are ill-defined and require novel scientific paradigms at the product level. • Contribute to the team's scientific agenda for agent monitoring, protection, remediation, validation research, and AI asset discovery. • Publish research results at peer-reviewed internal and external venues (e.g., USENIX Security, ACM CCS, IEEE S&P, NeurIPS, ICML security workshops, ICSE, PETS) when appropriate. • Articulate key scientific challenges of current and future AI security threats and deliver novel research to address them. • Design, implementation, and successful delivery of scientifically complex security solutions into production—both brand new systems and evolutions of existing ones. • Write significant portions of critical-path code for detection models, validation engines, protection technologies, and asset discovery / classification systems. • Assess and select appropriate technologies (e.g., data protection, private inference, graph-based anomaly detection, NLP-based service classification, code/traffic analysis for AI fingerprinting) for production systems. • Use best practices in scientific methodology and software engineering across the team; provide insightful peer reviews of code, design, and architecture artifacts. • Deliver solutions that are inventive, maintainable, scalable, and extensible. Influence • Autonomously drive discussions with security engineers, software engineers, product managers, and scientist peers across multiple teams. • Build consensus on larger cross-team security initiatives and factor complex efforts into independent workstreams. • Identify and resolve endemic problems, including areas where current security tooling limits innovation of partner teams. • Contribute to the broader internal and external scientific communities as a subject matter expert in AI security. jobs.jd: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. AI-First by Default At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does. Opportunity: Enterprise restaurant deployments are where voice AI meets the messiness of the real world: legacy systems, high transaction volumes, operational edge cases, and technology that has to work reliably during the busiest moments of the day. In this role, you will embed with leading restaurant brands and technology partners to make those deployments successful. You will learn how their systems work, design the integration path, write code, troubleshoot production issues, and adapt Deepgram’s platform to the constraints of live restaurant operations. You will work directly with customer engineering teams and business leaders, owning the technical path from early discovery through go-live and optimization. Your impact will extend beyond any single customer. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Prime Video - Ads Science
jobs.jd: Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! Key job responsibilities The science challenges include: - Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time. - Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals. - Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles. - Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies. - Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric. A day in the life - Contribute to the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind - Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale - Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization - Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements - Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions - Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions About the team Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale. - 3+ years of building models for business application experience - PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application - Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms - Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C++ Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. You will be the single point of influence who takes the high quality of our engineering delivery and extends it outward, ensuring that system integrator partners can deliver Cohere solutions with the same rigor, reliability, and innovation as our internal teams. As an Adoption Specialist, you will design, build, maintain, and deliver certification programs that validate partner expertise across infrastructure and agentic domains. You will report functionally into Customer Education & Transformation, with a dotted line into the Forward Deployed Engineering teams (Infrastructure and agentic), ensuring that every certification, every training program, and every competency standard reflects the latest innovation and the highest standards of delivery. We are seeking a unique individual: someone who is customer obsessed, has a background in infrastructure engineering with the technical grit and expertise to be a de facto member of the deployed engineering teams, while also bringing commercial acumen to scale these capabilities across the partner ecosystem. You will be the conduit between our internal engineering excellence and the broader market, and you will be the face of this program in front of partner networks and communities. In this role, you will: - Design, build, and maintain certification programs for system integrator partners across both infrastructure and agentic tracks, ensuring they reflect current technical realities and future innovation. This includes train-the-trainer programs with key system integrators that can certify on our behalf. - Develop deep subject matter expertise in end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout. jobs.title: Senior Gen AI Software Engineer
jobs.jd: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. Join Liftoff as a Senior Gen AI Software Engineer and help shape the future of ad tech. As a key member of our Gen AI team, you’ll design and build AI-powered products for our demand-side business, helping teams turn complex data into better decisions and meaningful customer growth. You’ll work across the stack, building intelligent systems and data pipelines in Python, alongside the TypeScript and React experiences that bring those capabilities to users. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to identify high-impact opportunities, move quickly from prototype to production, and continuously improve what you ship. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, product, and software engineering. You’ll help define how Liftoff applies modern AI to real business problems, balancing experimentation with the judgment and engineering discipline needed to build useful, reliable products. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys experimenting with new technology, and is motivated by turning promising AI capabilities into products that create real value. You’ll tackle complex problems, validate new approaches, and drive meaningful improvements across Liftoff. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own generative AI product capabilities end to end, from understanding user workflows and prototyping an approach through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing improvement. Rapidly prototype and validate AI solutions, using focused experiments to test user value and technical feasibility, then turn what works into production-ready capabilities. Build agentic workflows that can reason over campaign, customer, creative, and performance data, use well-defined tools, produce structured results, and hand control back to a person when appropriate. Partner closely with decision makers and subject matter experts to understand their workflows, constraints, and business context, then integrate AI agents into daily work in practical and useful ways. Design how AI systems access and use relevant information, including the data, tools, and instructions needed to produce useful grounded results. Build the systems that make AI workflows reliable in production, including tool use, state management, failure recovery, and appropriate boundaries for human review. Define clear, testable interfaces between models and software so uncertain model behavior can be handled safely within dependable product systems. Develop evaluation systems that measure whether AI features accomplish the intended task, using realistic examples and an appropriate combination of automated checks and human judgment. Build the instrumentation needed to understand quality, adoption, business impact, latency, cost, and failure modes in production. Apply appropriate safeguards for customer data, system access, and high-impact workflows. Build the Python services and TypeScript and React interfaces that turn these capabilities into cohesive products for customer facing teams. Evaluate new models and techniques pragmatically, adopting them when they materially improve product quality, capability, speed, or cost. Mentor other engineers and help establish shared practices for designing, testing, and operating AI-powered products. WHO YOU ARE Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience. You are a seasoned software engineer who has built and operated meaningful production products, ideally including zero-to-one work spanning backend services, data, and user interfaces. You have shipped LLM-powered or AI-assisted products beyond a demo and understand the practical challenges of reliability, context, tool use, provider changes, latency, cost, and changing model behavior. You are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working in TypeScript and React, with strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, SQL, and testing. You understand how to build the broader system around a model, including its data, tools, instructions, permissions, feedback loops, and measures of quality. You can define success criteria, investigate failures, and use testing, feedback, and production signals to improve AI experiences over time. You exercise strong product and engineering judgment, choosing when a problem calls for traditional software, an LLM-powered approach, or a thoughtful combination of both. You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with domain experts and non-technical partners. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and changing direction when evidence shows a better path. You are a lifelong learner with strong but flexible opinions, and you thrive on giving and receiving constructive feedback. Helpful, but not required Experience as an early engineer, startup founder, or in a similarly high-ownership environment where you moved quickly from ambiguous problems to shipped products. Experience with advertising technology, campaign optimization, performance marketing, analytics products, or other data-rich B2B software. Location: The preferred location for the role is in Pacific Standard Time Zone. This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA. We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Red

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app. This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams. What You Will Build Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems. Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows. Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence. Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production. Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust. Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale. What We Look For Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience. Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools. Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack. Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not. Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time. Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus. This Role Is Not For People who only want research projects with no production ownership. Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems. Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact. People who overclaim AI impact without evidence. Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About the Company Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development. In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment. Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most. Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment. Position Overview As a Senior AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will lead the technical build of AI systems across client engagements and internal products where speed, adaptability, and execution quality matter. You will own systems, not just features: shape architecture, make technical trade-offs, set engineering standards, and ship production-ready solutions across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, agents, and AI-driven workflows. You will own the infrastructure, deployment process, and security posture of the systems you lead. You will work directly with delivery leads and clients to turn vague business problems into clear technical plans. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership: you will mentor engineers, review their work, and raise the quality bar across the team. Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling. Primary Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled systems for client solutions, internal platforms, and products. Make architecture decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data models, AI components, cloud infrastructure, and deployment. Design and ship production AI capabilities: LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, agent and automation workflows, evaluation, and guardrails. Design and own cloud infrastructure: environments, networking, scaling, cost, and infrastructure as code. Own the deployment process across projects: CI/CD pipelines, release strategy, zero-downtime deploys, and rollbacks. Lead application and infrastructure security: threat modeling, access control, secrets management, data protection, and security reviews for client systems. Set and enforce standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, and reusable engineering patterns. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance. Work with delivery leads and clients to scope work, estimate effort, and flag technical risks early. Define how the team uses AI tools in development, and lead by example in daily use. Own production reliability: monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping software in professional environments. Deep experience with a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend stack (such as Python/FastAPI or Node.js). Strong experience with system design, APIs, and relational databases. Proven experience shipping LLM-powered systems to production (RAG, agents, tool use, evaluation, and guardrails). Infrastructure: deep experience designing and running production infrastructure on AWS or Google Cloud Platform, including containers (Docker, Kubernetes or Cloud Run), networking, scaling, monitoring, and infrastructure as code (such as Terraform). Deployments: proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines and release processes, including automated testing, staged environments, zero-downtime deployments, and rollback plans. Security: strong command of application and cloud security, including IAM and least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, OWASP Top 10, security reviews, and compliance-minded delivery for client data. A track record of owning production systems from architecture to launch and beyond. Experience mentoring engineers and leading code reviews. Strong ownership and judgment when requirements are unclear and priorities shift. Proficiency with GitHub and modern developer tooling. Excellent written and verbal communication, including with clients and non-technical stakeholders. Advanced daily use of AI tools across planning, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated output and hold the team to a high standard for correctness and reliability. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks, vector databases, and cost and latency tuning for AI systems. Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain or autonomous agent tooling. Client-facing experience in a consultancy, startup, or fast-iteration environment. Schedule and Location This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements. Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays. Technical Requirements Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed. jobs.jd: Relae (formerly Carbon Direct) helps organizations like Microsoft, Mitsubishi, and JPMorgan Chase make defensible, high-stakes decisions across energy strategy, decarbonization, environmental markets, and natural capital. Our teams combine scientific rigor with commercial and policy fluency to answer questions that matter, and we invest just as seriously in the people answering them, with a clear path for career growth, structured manager development, and real ownership of hard problems from day one. The Role Overview Relae is seeking an AI/ML Engineer for our Power, Data and Innovation team. This role will be responsible for designing, building, training, and maintaining machine learning models for production. You will be directly working with Relae ’s existing and prospective clients to provide insights and analysis on power hedging and procurement of electricity, gas and other energy commodities to help analyze operational and market risks and flexible load opportunities, including assessments of associated emissions impacts. This is an individual contributor role, and this role will work closely with software engineers, data scientists, energy economists, and power systems engineers to build models that support hyperscaler, utility, and corporate energy buyer clients navigating the AI-driven data center power boom. Responsibilities Leveraging a deep understanding of power systems data, identify, gather, and validate appropriate datasets for relevant power-sector applications, including assessment of uncertainties and data gaps, and develop analytical approaches to mitigate them. Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for energy market forecasting and grid analytics (data ingestion from ISO/utility feeds and weather sources, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring). Productionize forecasting and optimization models such as nodal price, load, or renewable generation forecasts with robust testing, observability, and documentation, in collaboration with cross-functional software and power advisory teams, and automated evaluations to ensure safe, frequent releases. Collaborate with power systems engineers and energy market analysts to translate research insights and domain expertise into performant, scalable forecasting and optimization systems. Contribute to technical design reviews, coding standards, and mentoring of best practices with the Tech & Software teams at Relea. Required Qualifications Experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment in power trading, energy procurement, commodity risk management, utility strategy, energy markets, or related roles. A master’s or a Ph.D. degree in applied statistics, applied economics, computer science, or a related field. Monitor real-time data for wholesale power markets, gas markets, congestion, basis, capacity, ancillary services, tariff developments, and regulatory changes that could affect portfolio cost or reliability. Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience in ML frameworks and time-series forecasting techniques applied to the power industry, along with a solid understanding of current ML approaches — including LLMs, predictive analytics, and agent-based modeling — as well as time-series-specific challenges such as non-stationarity, seasonality, avoiding data leakage, and appropriate cross-validation techniques. Ability to translate model outputs and technical tradeoffs into clear communication for non-technical audiences, including Relea’s existing and prospective clients Experience working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the product surface may evolve based on client needs Preferred Qualifications Power and energy advisory/consulting experience or experience in power product design Familiarity with weather-driven forecasting platforms or techniques (e.g., NWP data, ensemble weather models) and experience with grid optimization problems (e.g., storage dispatch, unit commitment, OPF) Salary Range $159,000-$195,000 a year Benefits: While we love our work, our lives aren’t defined by it. You will mentor junior data scientists through code and methodology reviews and share best practices across the team. You will operate effectively in ambiguous environments, use sound business judgment, show high ownership and a deep understanding of the AWS business, and apply new data science methods at AWS scale. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role As an Applied AI Engineer, you will turn model capabilities into real product behavior. You will own problems end-to-end, from shaping model behavior, to building the systems around it, to ensuring it performs reliably in production. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, systems, and product, focusing on making AI actually work for users, not just in demos, but in real-world usage. Focus Build and ship AI features end-to-end (model → system → user experience) Design and iterate on prompts, tools, memory, and agent workflows Turn raw model outputs into structured, reliable, and predictable behaviors Debug issues across the full stack (model, orchestration, infra, UX) Optimize for latency, cost, and production reliability Develop lightweight evaluation frameworks to measure real-world performance Work closely with product and engineering to translate ambiguous problems into working systems Tech Stack Python PyTorch / JAX LLMs (OpenAI-style APIs, LLaMA, Qwen, etc.) Inference / serving (e.g. vLLM) Vector DB Ideal Experience Strong foundation in machine learning and modern neural network architectures. Hands-on experience with training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models Ability to write clean, production-quality code Comfort working across abstraction layers (model → infra → product) Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement Outcomes ML models in production meet expected accuracy, latency, and reliability targets. Production issues are identified quickly, debugged effectively, and root causes addressed. Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are robust, reproducible, and maintainable. Collaborates effectively with engineers, product, and research teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features. Iterations on models and systems are driven by real-world signals and measurable improvements. How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical AI product. Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst / Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

In Token Factory analytics there is no split into product analysts, ML engineers and data engineers. Each person owns a question end to end: builds the data, runs the analysis, and comes back with a recommendation that changes a decision.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Define core product and business metrics and build a single source of truth that Product, Finance, and Sales can rely on.
- Build a comprehensive view of self-service customers, including usage patterns, customer health, satisfaction, retention risks, unmet needs, and growth opportunities.
- Translate customer demand and commercial plans into capacity forecasts and support capacity allocation decisions.
- Measure effective capacity utilization and identify opportunities to improve the commercial value of available capacity.
- Develop and evaluate pricing and packaging models, including guaranteed capacity, on-demand pricing, commitments, clawback mechanisms, and provisioned throughput units.
- Provide data-driven recommendations for the self-service and managed offerings, including customer segmentation, pricing, and capacity.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Finance, and Sales to turn insights into concrete product and operational improvements.

We expect you to have:

- 5+ years of experience in analytics or data science.
- Strong Python, SQL, and statistics: you understand the code and the methods you use.
- Hands-on experience analysing large-scale customer, product, and usage datasets using statistical / analytical or distributed data-processing tools.
- AI-assisted coding as your default way of working: you guide it, verify it, and own the result.
- The ability to go from a question to a production-ready solution.
- The ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations.
- Strong commercial and product judgment, with the ability to balance customer value, monetization, growth, and profitability.
- Experience with pricing, packaging, monetization, or commercial analytics for technical or consumption-based products.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Sales, and Operations.
- A hands-on and proactive working style, with the ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous and technically complex environment.

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with LLM inference economics: tokens, throughput and latency, batching, GPU costs.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist Greece
jobs.jd: Senior Data Scientist, Greece Role type: Full time Location: Greece (fully remote) Preferred start date: ASAP Salary: €2150-€7000 gross per month ABOUT SATALIA Satalia builds enterprise-grade AI systems for WPP and its FTSE 100 client base. Led by WPP Chief AI Officer Daniel Hulme, we run as a decentralised organisation where engineers and scientists own their domains end to end. Our data scientists are also at the core ofWPP Research, conducting frontier research and developing prototypes that evolve into tools used in production across WPP. THE ROLE Our current work includes: Agentic systems. Developing long-horizon agents that plan, use tools, and collaborate. We also build the core infrastructure to ensure reliability and governance at scale, spanning context/memory, observability, traffic control, and continuous verification. Federated and privacy-preserving learning. Training shared models when the data cannot move: federated LLM fine-tuning across independent data owners, and aggregation strategies that hold up under heterogeneous datasets. Identity intelligence. Predictive and probabilistic modelling on large behavioural datasets: propensity and similarity models, and probabilistic record linkage across data sources. Geospatial intelligence. Spatial statistics, geospatial feature engineering, and forecasting and optimisation over location data, plus computer vision on imagery. Synthetic data. Generating realistic synthetic data with known ground truth to stress-test models and agents under controlled adversarial conditions. You will be the technical lead across these workstreams: scoping the problem, choosing the modelling approach, building the training and evaluation infrastructure, and shipping to production by collaborating with engineers and domain experts across Satalia and WPP. WHAT YOU'LL DO Turn business problems into well-scoped data science projects. Develop models, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them safe and reliable. Lead projects end to end: plan the work, design the solution, and work with your team to deliver. Explain complex technical work clearly to engineers, domain experts, and senior stakeholders. Mentor data scientists and raise the quality bar across the team. MUST HAVE 5+ years building ML/AI models and taking them to production. Deep expertise in modelling techniques for both structured and unstructured data. Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems. Strong software engineering habits: Python, version control, testing, code review, CI/CD. Proven record of leading technical projects and mentoring other data scientists. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. NICE TO HAVE Experience with temporal and geospatial data. Experience building and testing agents in production. Experience with federated learning, clean rooms, or other privacy-preserving methods. Background in marketing technology, ad tech, audience modelling, or media mix modelling. Publications at top venues or meaningful open-source contributions. WHAT WE OFFER · Healthcare benefits · Remote working · Flexible working hours · Impactful projects · Continuous learning and development Satalia is home to some of the brightest minds in AI. If you're looking for a company that values autonomy and freedom and embraces a culture of inclusion and warmth, we'd love to hear from you. We aim to respond to all applications within 2 weeks. If you have not heard from us within 2 weeks this means your application has been unsuccessful. By applying to Satalia you are expressly giving your consent for the collection and use of your information as described within our Satalia Recruitment Privacy Policy. Good luck! jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Requirements The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment. High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations. Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000. Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom. Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions. Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows. jobs.jd:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Forward Deployed Engineer (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.
